profile.headline: Software Engineer at Red Hat
profile.summary: Back-end developer in Python, utilizing a microservices architecture, containerization, Agile methodologies, CI/CD principles, open source collaboration, and user-driven development in support of the hybrid cloud.  Seeking to transition to management where I can leverage my skills from my background beyond engineering in addition to all I've learned as an engineer, including valuable partnerships with product management, quality engineers, documentation teams, and marketing, in order to make a greater impact in supporting my teammates, championing user stories, and broadening perspectives to the benefit of all. It is my goal to leave the tech industry more diverse, inclusive, and equitable than when I entered it.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Undertook a four month internship in back-end development with Python and Django, building full-stack web apps for diverse clientele on an Agile development team.  Contributed to multiple, large code bases through writing code and documentation, pair programming, test driven development, unit testing, peer review, deployment, and acting on feedback from a professional QA team.

positions.title: Back-End Engineering with Python and Django -- Final Project:  ReEntry
positions.description:
Tackled a fast-paced, immersive, full-stack web development course, produced over two dozen apps and gained valuable professional skills including versioning control with Git, pair programming, test-driven development, and Agile methodologies.  Class culminated in a three week final project where my team of four identified a community need, researched it, and created a working web app that we would like to see grow.

Our app, ReEntry, helps connect the formerly incarcerated to those willing to hire them.  Built with a React front-end that interfaces with our Python and Django-based RESTful API on the back-end, ReEntry is designed to have a simple user interface to enable individuals who may not have much digital literacy to showcase the skills they do have, and contact potential employers whose positions they were matched to based on those skills. Our goal is to reduce our country's nearly eighty percent five-year recidivism rate by helping those who have already paid their debt to society to find the jobs and resources they need for achieving sustainable self-sufficiency.

positions.title: Assistant Manager

volunteerExperiences.description: Entering donors, donations, and volunteer information into their donation and newsletter tracking systems, updating and editing this information as needed, providing tax receipts, and sending thank you letters.

Helping with all aspects of the tour each April on both Saturday and Sunday from welcoming, parking, and education on biological risks to the animals and the need for shoe and hand washing, to cheese tastings, to sales, to setup and breakdown.  The tour is put together by CFSA (Carolina Farm Stewardship Association), but I was on Chapel Hill Creamery's personal volunteer team in addition to the CFSA-provided volunteers.
